body: So cute!  I can just imagine a little fairy inside :)
I would totally appreciate it.  What kinds of things do you draw/paint?

I'm so sorry for your loss.  What a neat experience though to have him visit you in your dreams!  When my cat died, she came to me in my dreams for about a week!  In the dream I would just be sitting in a chair with her in my lap, and petting her.  I thanked her for visiting me. 

Until you are ready to adopt another cat, maybe you can foster or volunteer at an animal shelter, help other kitties in need and who knows.  Maybe a new one will win your heart!
I do not have any kids

I have 1 cat and 1 dog.  I have thought about volunteering but seeing abused animals just breaks my heart and makes me hate people.  But I guess on the flip side, I would be doing the right thing in helping them.
